items.title: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.body:
Native speech-to-speech models with upgraded reasoning, near real-time visual understanding, automatic detection for 97 languages, and background tool calling. Extended Thinking adds deeper performance for complex tasks. Available in Gemini Live and API.
Why it matters: advances low-latency conversational agents with interleaved reasoning and visual grounding.
Watch next: developer adoption metrics and comparative speech-to-speech benchmarks.

items.title: xAI Grok Build receives substantial upgrade
items.body:
